newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico cattle report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 1,300 head were exported into the United States from Mexico at two crossing points Tuesday.
Through Santa Teresa, N.M., around 1,100 head were sold, although no trend prices were established.
"Trade inactive, no trend established Around 90 percent of cattle crossed were previously contracted on sold on video," USDA said.
Through Laredo, Texas, around 200 head were sold, although again with not enough sales to establish quote prices.
